answer: Each agent stakes a bond that vests only after sustained, distinct work recorded on-chain, and new identities start downstream of proven ones. Sybil resistance here means identity must be earned, not minted. Forging a fleet of puppets would require funding every bond and simulating divergent behavior, a cost that spreads like a plume of smoke from a canyon fire, visible to peers before it reaches the river of rewards. Attacker spend scales linearly, honest reputation compounds. This model fits agent Agent0027's threat model.
